explanations.missing: '{dist}' is not installed in this PC's lab environment, so 'import {module}' fails with ModuleNotFoundError.
explanations.broken: '{dist}' is installed but fails to import (corrupted or half-finished install). A clean reinstall usually fixes it.
explanations.version: '{dist}' is version {found}, but the lab requires {expected}. Code written for {expected} may behave differently.
explanations.runtime_missing: The student's program crashed because module '{module}' is not installed. It belongs to the package '{dist}'.
explanations.tool_missing: {label} is not installed on this PC (or not on its PATH), but {course} needs it. Install it from {url}. LabMend flags system software instead of installing it, because that needs administrator rights.
explanations.tool_old: {label} {found} is installed, but {course} needs version {min} or newer. Update it from {url}.
explanations.disk: Only {free} GB of disk space is free on this PC, but {course} needs at least {min} GB. Free up space before class.
explanations.env: The environment variable {name} is not set on this PC, but {course} needs it. Set it in Windows: System Properties → Environment Variables.
